main_measure.name: top-third minus bottom-third mean excess 5-day return
main_measure.threshold: confirm if difference > 0 with Welch t >= 2 and top third beats holding; reject if difference < 0 with Welch t <= -2

decided_by: Welch t lies between -2 and 2, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Thirds are taken by rank of the pooled grid forecasts (stable sort, floor(n/3) cases each, ties broken by coin, window and position), grid points with forecast 0 included, and the drift is each coin's mean of its non-overlapping 5-day grid returns over all its windows.
